shepherd.name: Shepherd
shepherd.line: You move toward people in pain and stay there. Hurting people feel safe with you.
shepherd.activity: sitting with someone in a hard season, listening without fixing
shepherd.desc: You are drawn to people in pain. You carry comfort, presence, and patient care into hard seasons, and people feel safe with you.

teacher.name: Teacher
teacher.line: You love the moment something clicks, for an adult in a study or a kid in a classroom.
teacher.activity: teaching a lesson, a class, or a group of kids so it actually sticks
teacher.desc: You love helping things click for people. Whether through a lesson, a story, a game, or a hands-on activity, you light up when someone finally understands.

discipler.name: Disciple-Maker
discipler.line: You play the long game: one person, over years, toward Jesus.
discipler.activity: meeting one-on-one with someone over months to help them grow
discipler.desc: You thrive in one-on-one spiritual investment. Walking with someone over time, asking good questions, and helping them take their next step is your sweet spot.

host.name: Host
host.line: You notice who's on the edges and make them feel they belong.
host.activity: welcoming people and making a room feel like home
host.desc: You make people feel they belong. You notice the new person, set the table, and create spaces where strangers become family.

artist.name: Artist
artist.line: You worship through craft: music, design, words, images.
artist.activity: music, design, or creative work for a worship service
artist.desc: You communicate and worship through craft. Beauty and excellence are part of your offering, and the church sees and sings because of you.

producer.name: Producer
producer.line: You make Sunday work from the booth: sound, slides, lights, stream, calm under pressure.
producer.activity: running sound, slides, or the livestream on a Sunday
producer.desc: You make the service happen from behind the scenes. Technology, calm under pressure, and a love for things running smoothly are your gifts.

evangelist.name: Evangelist
evangelist.line: You come alive around people far from God, and they can tell you like them.
evangelist.activity: spiritual conversations with people who don't believe
evangelist.desc: You come alive around people far from God. Spiritual conversations, invitations, and faith stories feel natural to you, not forced.

mercy.name: Mercy-Bearer
mercy.line: Your compassion has hands. Meals, rides, crisis help, practical love.
mercy.activity: meeting a tangible need with hands-on help
mercy.desc: You meet tangible needs with hands-on compassion. Food, shelter, advocacy, showing up in crisis: this is where your faith gets practical.

intercessor.name: Intercessor
intercessor.line: Prayer isn't a duty for you. It's your native language.
intercessor.activity: praying for and with people, consistently and persistently
intercessor.desc: Prayer is not a duty for you; it is your native language. You carry people and burdens before God faithfully and persistently.

administrator.name: Administrator
administrator.line: You bring order out of chaos, and ministries run better because of you.
administrator.activity: running the systems, details, and logistics behind a ministry
administrator.desc: You bring order out of chaos. Systems, details, schedules, and logistics hum when you are involved.

strategist.name: Strategist
strategist.line: You see the big picture and the path to get there.
strategist.activity: evaluating a ministry honestly and shaping where it should go
strategist.desc: You see the big picture and the path to get there. Diagnosing problems, shaping vision, and building plans energizes you.

mobilizer.name: Mobilizer
mobilizer.line: You rally people and help them find where their gifts get used.
mobilizer.activity: recruiting, connecting, and plugging people into the right place
mobilizer.desc: You rally people. Recruiting, connecting, and helping others find their place on a team is something you do almost without thinking.

pioneer.name: Pioneer
pioneer.line: Blank pages excite you more than full ones. You start what doesn't exist yet.
pioneer.activity: starting something new where there's no roadmap
pioneer.desc: You are wired to start new things. Blank pages, new neighborhoods, and unproven ideas excite you more than maintaining what already exists.
